title: Keep a cached shipment from changing under its rate

cases.says: two shipments built separately from the same carrier and parcels find the same cached rate, and a different weight does not
withParcel returns a shipment with the extra parcel, and the original keeps its parcels and its cached rate
when the caller changes the map it built a shipment from, the shipment keeps its parcels and its rate is still found
code that removes a parcel from the map parcels() returns does not change the shipment, and its rate is still found

origin.section: A Record Is Only Shallowly Immutable: a List Component Can Change Under a Map Key
